annual_policy: every twelve elapsed monthly returns; no rebalance before twelve returns
threshold_policy: rebalance when absolute post-return weight deviation reaches five percentage points
trade_timing: monthly returns precede simulated trades; not an executable closing-quote strategy
missing_outcome_policy: unavailable, never zero; ten-year loss unavailable until sufficient observations
selection_policy: no optimization or removal of underperforming scenarios
admission_requirements: real baseline and source availability timestamps
entry receipt before outcome observation period
independent timestamp evidence binding protocol and receipt hashes
history_policy: preserve released history; revisions require a separate labeled run
scope: prospective monthly reference portfolios; no ETF execution or historical-vintage certification
